name: 15834 · Emporium, PA
findings: ZIP 15834 (Emporium) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15834 (Emporium) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15834 (Emporium) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
